statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54515 (GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v): when case-insensitive property matching was enabled for a bean with @JsonFormat(ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES), BeanDeserializerBase.createContextual rebuilt the property map from the bean's original, unfiltered properties, so a property excluded by a per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties could be set from untrusted JSON again. com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind 2.8.0 to 2.18.8, 2.19.0 to 2.21.4 and 2.22.0 are affected, and 2.18.9, 2.21.5 and 2.22.1 fix it; the Jackson 3 artifact tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind is affected from 3.1.0 before 3.1.4. Advisory: https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/security/advisories/GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v. The 2.x fix is commit bc1613c on the 2.18 branch, from pull request 6039, which backports the fix for issue 5962 and makes createContextual rebuild the map from the filtered contextual deserializer: https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/bc1613c765704703ec7385e314fa8b19448e1ddd. The jackson-databind-2.18.9, jackson-databind-2.21.5 and jackson-databind-2.22.1 tags contain it, and jackson-databind-2.18.8 and jackson-databind-2.22.0 do not. This package is the Gradle 8 build tool, which bundles jackson-databind. We read every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, x86_64 and aarch64: 16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0, each matching its repository index checksum. 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only, and every aarch64 package has the same index checksum as its x86_64 package. Each package ships jackson-databind as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/jackson-databind-<version>.jar, and its version comes from the Maven metadata inside the jar, not from the file name: 2.18.6 in 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.5-r3, 2.18.8 in 8.14.5-r4 and 8.14.5-r5, 2.18.9 in 8.14.5-r6 to 8.14.5-r9, 2.18.11 in 8.14.6-r0 to 8.14.7-r0 and 2.18.12 in 8.14.8-r0. Each of these jackson-databind jars has the same SHA-256 as the jar of that version on Maven Central. The class files agree: in com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerBase.class, createContextual takes the property map it rebuilds for case-insensitive matching from the bean itself in jackson-databind 2.18.6 and 2.18.8, and from the filtered contextual deserializer in 2.18.9, 2.18.11 and 2.18.12. Each package has exactly one jackson-databind jar; no other jar in it, including jars nested inside jars, contains jackson-databind classes under any package prefix, and no package ships Jackson 3 classes under tools/jackson. The range ends at 8.14.5-r6, the first build with a fixed jackson-databind; 8.14.5-r5 and every earlier build carry an affected one.

CVE-2026-54515 (GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v): when case-insensitive property matching was enabled for a bean with @JsonFormat(ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES), BeanDeserializerBase.createContextual rebuilt the property map from the bean's original, unfiltered properties, so a property excluded by a per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties could be set from untrusted JSON again. com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind 2.8.0 to 2.18.8, 2.19.0 to 2.21.4 and 2.22.0 are affected, and 2.18.9, 2.21.5 and 2.22.1 fix it; the Jackson 3 artifact tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind is affected from 3.1.0 before 3.1.4. Advisory: https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/security/advisories/GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v. The 2.x fix is commit bc1613c on the 2.18 branch, from pull request 6039, which backports the fix for issue 5962 and makes createContextual rebuild the map from the filtered contextual deserializer: https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/bc1613c765704703ec7385e314fa8b19448e1ddd. The jackson-databind-2.18.9, jackson-databind-2.21.5 and jackson-databind-2.22.1 tags contain it, and jackson-databind-2.18.8 and jackson-databind-2.22.0 do not. This package is the Gradle 9 build tool, which bundles jackson-databind. We read every published gradle-9 package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository: 13 versions, 9.6.1-0 to 9.9.1-2, each an architecture-independent package that the amd64 and arm64 indexes list with the same checksum, and each matching that checksum. Each package ships jackson-databind as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/jackson-databind-<version>.jar, and its version comes from the Maven metadata inside the jar, not from the file name: 2.18.6 in 9.6.1-0, 2.22.0 in 9.7.0-0 to 9.8.0-0 and 2.22.3 in 9.8.1-0 to 9.9.1-2. These Debian packages carry their own builds of the jackson-databind jar, so the class files below were read from the jar in each package.
